Laguna Beach Residences Bayside

Condominium in Bang Tao
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleLaguna Beach Residences Bayside

Images from Keller Henson and Papaya Property developer marketing materials. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Laguna Beach Residences Bayside is a low-rise condominium within the Laguna Phuket master plan at Bang Tao, a development of the Banyan Group. Agent listings describe apartments from about 73 sqm up to penthouses of roughly 359 sqm.

Agent sources disagree on the exact number of units (234 to 237) and on the completion date (between Q2 and Q4 2028), so we show only the year. A payment plan of five 20% steps tied to signing, construction progress and completion appears in one agent listing; confirm it with us before relying on it.

Prices differ between agents. The starting price shown is the lowest we found; ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list.

Floor plans & site plan

Payment information

  • 20% at contract signing
  • 20% at 25% construction progress
  • 20% at 50% construction progress
  • 20% at 75% construction progress
  • 20% on completion, followed by title transfer / lease registration

Frequently asked questions

Where is Laguna Beach Residences Bayside?

Laguna Beach Residences Bayside is a condominium project in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Banyan Group (Laguna Property).

What is the starting price of Laguna Beach Residences Bayside?

Agent advertised price is ฿22,340,000, last checked 2026-11-17. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

When will Laguna Beach Residences Bayside be ready?

Current status: under construction; completion date listed as 2028 (agent listings differ: Q2, Q4, October). Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
